name: trademark-similarity-analysis
description: Applies the 13-factor DuPont likelihood-of-confusion analysis (In re E.I. du Pont de Nemours & Co., 476 F.2d 1357) to each identified conflict candidate. Scores mark similarity (sight/sound/meaning), goods/services relatedness, channels of trade, consumer sophistication, and senior-mark strength. Emits a structured DuPont-factor table and an overall likelihood-of-confusion rating per conflict.

related_flows.description: outputs likelihood_of_confusion_rating, dupont_factor_table consumed by trademark-risk-report
